setenv AETHER_SE_TRACENET_DEPTH 6 means that it checks if the speciﬁed net has a short net within 6 levels. If this environment variable is not set, the default value is 5.

##### AETHER_SYN_LEVEL0

Value Type int Description This environment variable controls whether the synchronization message box pops up. For example:

setenv AETHER_SYN_LEVEL0 1 means that the synchronization message does not need to pop up and only level0 is updated. When unsetenv AETHER_SYN_LEVEL0 or setenv AETHER_SYN_LEVEL0 0 , this environment variable is not valid.

AETHER_TRACE_GLOBAL_DEPTH* Value Type

number

##### Description

Specify the Depth of the hierarchy when searching for global net in SE Trace Net.

∗ 0 or not set: Do not search for the global net within the lower-level Cell.

∗ > 0: Search whether there is the speciﬁed global net within N levels

of all Instances in the top cell. If so, highlight the Instance. AETHER_UNCHOOSE_EXPORT_POPUP_WINDOW*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to pop up the window to select the certain view to annotate for Run ArgusLVS.

For example: setenv AETHER_UNCHOOSE_EXPORT_POPUP_WINDOW 1 means that it will pop up the window to select the certain view to annotate for Run ArgusLVS.

AETHER_USED_EMPYREAN_CACHE

Value Type bool

##### Description

This environment variable controls whether to use empyrean’s cache mechanism, it can only be applied to Aether which based on CHQ database. If setting this variable will use empyrean’s cache mechanism. Otherwise, it will use CHQ’s cache mechanism.

AETHER_VCELL_CACHE_ENABLE_ALL

Value Type bool Description

This variable controls whether Aether generates the cache of AGR or all VCell/PyCell. If this variable not set, Aether only generates the cache of AGR.

||Note: It works only when AETHER_VCELL_CACHE_ENABLE is set.|
|---|
|
|---|


AETHER_VCELL_CACHE_ENABLE

Value Type bool Description

This variable enable the VCell/PyCell cache feature. If it is set, Aether will read the VCell/PyCell cache ﬁrstly. If the VCell/PyCell cache can not be found, Aether will generate the VCell/PyCell cache. After setting this variable, the performance of opening the top design will be accelerated obviously.

AETHER_VCELL_CACHE_LIBLIST Value Type

string

##### Description

This variable controls the libraries which VCell/PyCell cache can work in. If this environment variable is not set, the VCell/PyCell can work in all the libraries. The libraries must be separated by spaces when setting this variables.

||Note: It works only when AETHER_VCELL_CACHE_ENABLE is set.|
|---|
|
|---|


AETHER_VER_DATADM

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the data.dm ﬁle under the cell is checked in, checked out, or discarded along with the view named "schematic" or views of type Verilog, SystemVerilog, and VerilogA when using version control tools.

For example:

setenv AETHER_VER_DATADM means that when executing Check In, Check Out, or Discard operations on a view named "schematic" or views of type Verilog, SystemVerilog, and VerilogA, the data.dm ﬁle under the corresponding cell of that view will also be simultaneously checked in,checked out or discarded.

AETHER_VER_SPEEDMODE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the eﬃciency of some functions when using version control tools.

For example:

setenv AETHER_VER_SPEEDMODE means that executing operations such as Delete or Update Selection on data managed by dMan will result in faster refresh of the form content when switching to display type Cells. Additionally, all options in the Show Filters will become grayed out and non-editable.

![image 10929](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10929.png)

![image 10930](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10930.png)

(a) Don’t Set Environment Variable (b) Set Environment Variable

Figure L.2 the Delete form with dMan

AETHER_VIA_SELECTION_MODE Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ﬁlter mode for selecting vias, including FORBID , IGNORE_LAYERS , CUT_LAYERS or NON_CUT_ LAYERS .

∗ FORBID : no matter how, via cannot be selected; ∗ IGNORE_LAYERS : default value, don’t ﬁlter by layer; ∗ CUT_LAYERS : if the cut’s layer in LSW is not selectable, the via

cannot be selected; ∗ NON_CUT_LAYERS : if the top layer and the bottom layer in LSW

are both not selectable, the via cannot be selected. DMAN_HIDE_DEL_FROM_SERVER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable hides the Delete From Server option in the Delete menu in Design Manager.

For example: setenv DMAN_HIDE_DEL_FROM_SERVER means that Delete From Server option will be invisible.

##### DMAN_HIDE_OPEN_DMAN

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable hides Open dMan(Design Manager -> dMan

-> Open dMan). For example: setenv DMAN_HIDE_OPEN_DMAN means that Open dMan action will be invisible.

DM_PRINT_COPY_MSG*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the result information of copy operations is printed in the Cmd&&Msg panel.

For example:

setenv DM_PRINT_COPY_MSG means that the information of copy will be printed in the Cmd&&Msg panel, as shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10931](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10931.png)

Figure L.3 Copy Message

##### EMY_AETHER_ABUTFUNCTION_FLOW

Value Type bool Description This environment variable switches the abut ﬂow. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_ABUTFUNCTION_FLOW means that user’s PDK device is using abut function. Aether will ﬁnd the abut function and trigger it, when abut is operating.

EMY_AETHER_ANNOTATE_STYLE_MDEL2

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to use annotate style to display annotate voltage or current in MDEL2.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_ANNOTATE_STYLE_MDEL2 means that cdsTerm will be used to display annotate voltage or current. If this environment variable is not set, the old style will be used.

EMY_AETHER_ARGUS_NOMODIFY_NETLITSCMD*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to modify the special characters on the netlist command line.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_ARGUS_NOMODIFY_NETLITSCMD means that the netlist command line is not modiﬁed. If you don’t set this environment variable, it will modify the netlist command line.

##### EMY_AETHER_CANCEL_QT_SHORTCUT

Value Type bool Description This environment variable cancels the Ctrl+W shortcut of the interface. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_CANCEL_QT_SHORTCUT means that it cancels the Ctrl+W shortcut used to close the interface.

EMY_AETHER_CDL_NO_PREFIX

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the device instance with an empty CDF preﬁx is preﬁxed with X.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_CDL_NO_PREFIX means that if the CDF preﬁx is empty, the device instance is not preﬁxed with X. If you don’t set this environment variable, the preﬁx X is added.

EMY_AETHER_CDL_NOTSAVE_HEADER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the CDL Header option of the Export Netlist feature is saved. If the environment variable is set, the CDL Header will not be saved. Otherwise, it will be saved.

EMY_AETHER_CDL_PROC

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether or not to use the default netlist procedure when the CDF netlist procedure is empty.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_CDL_PROC means that the CDL does not use the default netlist procedure when the CDF netlist procedure is empty. If you don’t set this environment variable, the default netlist procedure will be used.

EMY_AETHER_CDSPARAM_NONE_ANNOTATE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the CDF parameter whether to use annotate.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_CDSPARAM_NONE_ANNOTATE 1 means that the Use cdsParam to display is none or noset will be annotated.

##### EMY_AETHER_CFGNETLIST_GET_RCFILE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to load aether.rc ﬁle when exporting netlist by using command line.

EMY_AETHER_CHECK_RO_DESIGN*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether you can check the read-only unchecked schematic before simulation.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_CHECK_RO_DESIGN means that you can check read-only unchecked schematic before simulation.

EMY_AETHER_CLEAN_FAKE_LOCK

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the behavior of lock clean ﬂow after crash, whether to clean the locks hold by Aether or not.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_CLEAN_FAKE_LOCK 1 means that the locks will be cleaned after crash. Otherwise, the locks won’t be cleaned.

EMY_AETHER_DEFAULT_MFG*

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls the grid resolution for manufacturing in the default technology. The valid value range is from 1 to 10.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_DEFAULT_MFG 1 means that the manufacturing grid of the default technology is set to 0.001 * 1.

EMY_AETHER_DEVICE_MATCH_CANNOT_SELOBJINGRP

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether you can edit objects inside a device matching group without ungrouping it when Select Inside Objects In Group is checked.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_DEVICE_MATCH_CANNOT_SELOBJING RP 1 means that you cannot edit objects inside a device matching group without ungrouping it.

EMY_AETHER_DIRECTPLOT_WITH_INFO*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the protocol sent by Direct Plot includes information of -param and/or -corner. The feature takes eﬀect as long as the environment variable is set.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_DIRECTPLOT_WITH_INFO means that the protocol sent by Direct Plot will include information of -param and/or -corner.

##### EMY_AETHER_DISABLE_GROUP_ORIGIN*

Value Type bool Description This environment variable deﬁnes the instance label generation method. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_DISABLE_GROUP_ORIGIN 1 means that label will not adjust position when creating label for instance.

EMY_AETHER_DISABLE_MENU_SHORTCUT*

Value Type bool

This environment variable disables Alt shortcut keys for activating menus. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_DISABLE_MENU_SHORTCUT means that when set Alt shortcut keys, action will trigger command directly, suppressing menu display.

##### EMY_AETHER_DMAN_CANCEL_TOP*

Value Type bool Description This environment variable controls the stay-on-top property of version action forms. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_DMAN_CANCEL_TOP means that version forms will not be always on top. EMY_AETHER_DMAN_CLIO_VERSION

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether some of options in each form of dman are displayed.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_DMAN_CLIO_VERSION means that "Discard Selected Checkouts By Everyone" in the discard form will be displayed.

EMY_AETHER_DOUBLE_CLICK_NO_PROMPT*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable determines whether the Descend Prompt window will appear when double-clicking to enter a symbol after enabling the Prompt View Name option in the Descent window.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_DOUBLE_CLICK_NO_PROMPT means that the Descend Prompt window will not appear.

##### EMY_AETHER_EIP_NOTIN_PCELL*

Value Type bool Description This environment variable controls the ﬁltered objects for Edit In Place. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_EIP_NOTIN_PCELL means that Edit In Place can not enter PCell and can not highlight PCell.

##### EMY_AETHER_EIP_QUERY_PRBOUNDARY_AND_BLOCKAGE

Value Type bool Description This environment variable controls the highlight for Edit In Place. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_EIP_QUERY_PRBOUNDARY_AND_BLO CKAGE means that the Edit In Place can highlight PRBoundary and Blockage objects.

![image 10932](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10932.png)

![image 10933](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10933.png)

(a) Don’t Set Environment Variable (b) Set Environment Variable

Figure L.4 Edit In Place

EMY_AETHER_EXTRACT_LIMIT

Value Type int

This environment variable controls query times of updating connectivity when design is modiﬁed.

##### EMY_AETHER_FIND_ON_FIRSTLAYOUT*

Value Type bool Description This environment variable is set to ﬁnd/replace form activation mode. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_FIND_ON_FIRSTLAYOUT means that the ﬁnd/replace form takes eﬀect only on the layout that starts it.

EMY_AETHER_GEN_SELECT_LIST_LIMIT* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable limits the number of SDL -> Generate Selected From Schematic -> Unplaced Instances List.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_GEN_SELECT_LIST_LIMIT 1000 means that SDL -> Generate Selected From Schematic -> Unplaced Instances List will show instances no more than 1000.

EMY_AETHER_GENCLONE_OPT_ORDER*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable enables the optimized clone search feature. This function prioritizes the search based on the relative positions of instances in the schematic, meaning that when the instances are arranged in a relatively orderly manner, the clone search algorithm will achieve certain performance improvements.

EMY_AETHER_GET_REF_PINORDER*

Value Type bool

##### Description

This environment variable controls whether to use the property portOrder in used design.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_GET_REF_PINORDER 1 means that can use the property portOrder to export netlist.

EMY_AETHER_GRAVITY_USE_OBJECT_FILTER*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the object can be gravitated or not through the Object Filter.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_GRAVITY_USE_OBJECT_FILTER 1 means that can not gravitate to an object that ﬁltered by Object Filter.

##### EMY_AETHER_HSPICE_PREFIX_ADD

Value Type bool Description This environment variable controls whether to add a preﬁx. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_HSPICE_PREFIX_ADD means that if the CDF preﬁx and the initial letter of the instance name are duplicated, the preﬁx should also be added. If you don’t set this environment variable, the preﬁx is not added.

EMY_AETHER_IGNORE_SET_TCLPRECISION

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether setting the value of tcl_precision is ignored.

For example:

![image 10934](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10934.png)

![image 10935](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10935.png)

(a) Not Set Environment (b) Set Environment

Figure L.5 Ignore Setting tcl_precision Variable

EMY_AETHER_IMPROVE_CUTSHAPE_DISPLAY

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to improve the display precision of cut shapes.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_IMPROVE_CUTSHAPE_DISPLAY

means that the display precision of cut shapes is improved. If Options -> Settings -> Display -> Filter Level is set to 4, the cut shapes are displayed by level 1 approximately.

EMY_AETHER_INFO_LOCATION_LEFTTOP

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the Object Information Tooltip is displayed at the top-left corner of drawarea. If the environment variable is set, the Object Information Tooltip will appear at the top-left corner of drawarea. Otherwise, the Object Information Tooltip will be displayed next to the mouse cursor.

EMY_AETHER_INI_FILE_PATH Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable customizes the path of the Aether ini ﬁle in the installation package and the user’s home directory, and it can be used

in conjunction with another environment variable EMY_AETHER_INI_LOAD_HIGHEST_PRIORITY , which is to use the user-deﬁned Aether ini ﬁle for the ﬁnal load. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_INI_FILE_PATH ﬁlePath means that it speciﬁes a user-deﬁned ﬁle path.

EMY_AETHER_INI_LOAD_HIGHEST_PRIORITY

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable is intended to be combined with a to allow the user to customize the ﬁle to be loaded last.

##### EMY_AETHER_INSTANCEPLACEMENT_SORT_BY_NAME

Value Type bool Description This environment variable sorts instance names. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_INSTANCEPLACEMENT_SORT_BY_NAM E 1 means that instance placement order in columns is sorted by instance name.

EMY_AETHER_LE_ADVTRACE_NUMBER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the result information of the Query -> Advanced Trace Net -> Trace operations are printed in the Cmd&&Msg panel.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_LE_ADVTRACE_NUMBER means that the information of the Query -> Advanced Trace Net -> Trace will be printed in the Cmd&&Msg panel, as shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10936](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10936.png)

Figure L.6 Advanced Trace Net Message

EMY_AETHER_LE_LABELPIN_ROTATE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the rotate settings of Create Label or Create Pin are preserved in layout. Setting it to 1 retains rotate settings until Aether restarts. If not set, the rotate settings reset to default each time Create Label or Create Pin is used.

EMY_AETHER_LOGFILE_SAMEWITH_GDS*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the gdsOut.log ﬁle will be generated in the same directory as the GDS ﬁle when run DRC/LVS.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_LOGFILE_SAMEWITH_GDS means that the gdsOut.log ﬁle will be generated in the directory where the GDS ﬁle is located.

EMY_AETHER_LSW_VERTICAL_ARRANGEMENT*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the order of layer icons displayed when layer selection widget is clicked.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_LSW_VERTICAL_ARRANGEMENT means that the layer icons are arranged in the same order as the layers in the LSW by the column direction, as shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10937](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10937.png)

Figure L.7 Arrange in both the row and column directions

EMY_AETHER_MAX_HILIT_OBJ_NUM_SIZE Value Type

number

Description This environment variable controls max number of highlight objects. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_MAX_HILIT_OBJ_NUM_SIZE 10 means that the max number of highlight objects will be 10 times the size of the original. The range of support is from 1 to 100 inclusive.

EMY_AETHER_MDE_DIRECTPLOT_COLOR* Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the color of the ﬁrst plotted waveform by MDEL2 -> Results -> Direct Plot.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_MDE_DIRECTPLOT_COLOR red means that

the ﬁrst waveform color is red. The list of colors that can be speciﬁed is as follows: yellow, red, blueviolet, deeppink, magenta, palevioletred, cyan, gold, orangered and springgreen.

EMY_AETHER_MDE_MAX_THREAD* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the maximum number of threads for simulator’s simulation.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_MDE_MAX_THREAD 128 meas that the max threads is 128 for simulator’s simulation. If this environment variable is not set, set to a value that cannot be converted to an integer, or set to an integer number less than 99, the default value 99 takes eﬀect.

EMY_AETHER_MSR_ERR_STRICTPORTMATCH*

Value Type bool Description

Setting this environment variable, routed wires bend from the side which user selected after pressing Start in Route -> Min Spacing Routing and Route -> Equal Resistivity Routing. If it is not set, routed wires will bend from the side automatically selected by algorithm internal.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_MSR_ERR_STRICTPORTMATCH means that the routed wires bend from the side which user selected after pressing Start, as shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10938](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10938.png)

Figure L.8 Routing wire bend direction EMY_AETHER_MT_AUTO_RATIO

Value Type bool Description

Setting this environment variable, in multi-technology design, the display and editing operations will automatically scale to the actual size if dbu diﬀer.

For example:

In a multi-technology design, there is an instance (inst) with a diﬀerent technology conﬁguration. The DBU (Database Unit) of this instance is 4000, while the current design’s DBU is 1000. The instance contains a rectangle with a side length of 1 um. By default (without scaling logic), the rectangle’s side length would be displayed as 4 um in the design. setenv EMY_AETHER_MT_AUTO_RATIO means that the rectangle’s side length in the instance will be scaled according to the current design’s technology precision, resulting in a corrected display of 1 um.

EMY_AETHER_MT_IGNORE_GRIDWARN*

Value Type bool Description

Setting this environment variable, in multi-technology design, the system will ignore grid precision loss warnings during EIP (Hierarchy -> Edit In Place) to lower-tier dies.

For example:

In a multi-technology design, there is an die with a diﬀerent technology conﬁguration. The DBU (Database Unit) of this die is higher then the current design, the displayed grid does not meet current process requirements. When EIP to this die, there will be popup a warning box for grid precision loss detected. setenv EMY_AETHER_MT_IGNORE_GRID

WARN means that the warning box will be ignored. EMY_AETHER_MTTRACENET_VIA_MERGE

Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable accelerates multi-technology trace net commands by merging excessive via cut patterns into a single bounding-box shape on the via cut layer when the number of cuts exceeds threshold.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_MTTRACENET_VIA_MERGE 4 means that it triggers automatic merging of all cut-layer shapes into a single uniﬁed

shape when the number of cut patterns in inter-die trace vias exceeds 4, as shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10939](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10939.png)

Figure L.9 Merge via shape for multi-technology trace net

EMY_AETHER_MT_INTERP*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to enable multi-interpreter loading mode.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_MT_INTERP 1 means that enable the multiinterpreter loading mode, which an interpreter will be loaded for each library except main interpreter.

EMY_AETHER_MULTI_PVE_WINDOW*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether one Aether can open multiple PVE windows.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_MULTI _PVE_WINDOW means that one Aether can open multiple PVE windows.

##### EMY_AETHER_N2S_TIE_LOWCASE* Value Type

bool Description

This environment variable controls the net names for Tie high and Tie low when importing Verilog netlists through Import Netlist. By default, Tie high is converted to "VDD" and Tie low to "VSS". Setting this environment variable will convert them to "vdd" and "vss" respectively.

EMY_AETHER_NAVIGATOR_POSTEXPAND

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the behavior of the selection in the Navigator, whether the related nodes are expanded or not. And when this environment variable is set, the performance of Navigator will be improved. Otherwise, the original behavior is maintained.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_NAVIGATOR_POSTEXPAND means that when

a net node is selected in the Navigator, the group node containing the net is no longer actively expanded. The same applies to bus net nodes, cell nodes, etc.

EMY_AETHER_NAVIGATOR_UNGEN_CONTROL

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the display behavior of ungenerated nodes in the Navigator. Setting it helps to reduce performance overhead caused by unnecessary data fetching.

EMY_AETHER_NETLISTMAP_COMPAT_OLD*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to be compatible with the legacy netlist map ﬁle.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NETLISTMAP_COMPAT_OLD means that the tool will be compatible with the legacy netlist map ﬁle.

EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_GET_TERMORDER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to output pins in order when exporting netlist.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_GET_TERMORDER means that pins are output in order when exporting netlist. If you don’t set this environment variable, pins are output out of order.

EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_NO_CACHE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to use cache when exporting netlist.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_NO_CACHE means that the cache is not used when exporting netlist. If you don’t set this environment variable, the cache is used.

EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_WAIT Value Type

number

Description This environment variable controls the waiting time for netlist process. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_NETLIST_WAIT 10 means that reg playback will wait 10 minutes for netlist process.

EMY_AETHER_NOCOPY_SE2LE

Value Type bool

##### Description

This environment variable blocks copying objects from schematic/symbol views to layout views.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_NOCOPY_SE2LE means that copying from schematic/symbol to layout is disabled.

EMY_AETHER_NOT_LOAD_AUTOSAVE*

Value Type int Description

Upon opening the design window, Aether will prompt the user to load the automatically saved content. This environment variable controls whether to disable this feature.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NOT_LOAD_AUTOSAVE 1 means that the feature is disabled.If you set it to 0 or leave it unset,this feature is not disabled.

EMY_AETHER_NOT_REFRESH_USERACTION*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether refresh user actions in component. If the environment variable is set, the user actions will not be refreshed; otherwise, the user actions will be refreshed normally.

EMY_AETHER_NOT_SEL_INST_EDGE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to select the edge of a scalar instance for stretching.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NOT_SEL_INST_EDGE means that the edge of scalar instance cannot be selected when selecting partial array is enabled.

EMY_AETHER_NOT_SKIP_DERIVED

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether a error message is generated when the layer is a derived layer.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_NOT_SKIP_DERIVED 1 means that an error needs to be reported when the layer is a derived layer.

EMY_AETHER_NOT_SKIP_NON_DEFAULT

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to output default layer in NONDEFAULTRULES when exporting DEF.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NOT_SKIP_NON_DEFAULT 1 means that default layer is outputed in NONDEFAULTRULES when exporting DEF.

EMY_AETHER_NO_CHECK_LIB_PATH

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the behavior of refresh after library path has been changed.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NO_CHECK_LIB_PATH 1 means that refreshing is allowed whether the library path has been changed or not. Otherwise, refreshing is forbidden if the library path has been changed.

EMY_AETHER_NO_SIMPROBE_HSPICE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to add the sim probe signal to the sp ﬁle. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NO_SIMPROBE_HSPICE means that the sim probe signal is not added to the sp ﬁle. If you don’t set this environment variable, the sim probe signal will be added.

##### EMY_AETHER_NO_SOS

Value Type bool Description This environment variable disables the integration of the SOS. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_NO_SOS means that disable the use of SOS as version management tool. If you don’t set this environment variable, version control defaults to the conﬁguration speciﬁed in the aether.rc ﬁle.

EMY_AETHER_PAN_MAP_LIMIT Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the limit size of the panning pixmap and the unit is pixel. In order to improve the performance of panning, the panning pixmap is used to display directly when the view area is already drawn in it. It may cause performance issue if the value is speciﬁed too large.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_PAN_MAP_LIMIT 3000 means that it resets the size of the panning pixmap when the width or height is larger than 3000. If user has not set, the default value is 5000.

EMY_AETHER_PIN_SNAP_TRACK

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether pins need to snap to the track while moving or copying or stretching or creating.

setenv EMY_AETHER_PIN_SNAP_TRACK means that pins need to snap to the track while moving or copying or stretching or creating.

EMY_AETHER_PLACEMENT_VIRTUAL_PINS

Value Type bool Description

This environment controls the pin placement to display virtual pins or net shapes.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_PLACEMENT_VIRTUAL_PINS means that the pin placement shows virtual pins.

EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_CELLVIEW_SPACE_LIMIT* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the lower limit of the disk space (in gigabytes) of the cell view directory.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_CELLVIEW_SPACE_LIMIT 100 means that the lower limit for the disk space of the cell view directory is 100G. This lower limit is checked when launching a simulation run. If the currently available disk space is less than this lower limit, the simulation run will be aborted. If this environment variable is not set, or set to a string which cannot be converted to a number, no disk space checking will take place.

EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_EVALUATE_MULTI_THREAD

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls if multi-threading is enabled for result expression evaluation, either during simulations or re-evaluation. When multi-threading is enabled, each individual test is assigned one dedicated evaluation thread. Evaluations within one particular test are still executed in sequence, but evaluations across tests are in parallel.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_EVALUATE_MULTI_THREA D 0 means that it disables multi-threading evaluation. Otherwise, it enables multi-threading evaluation. Typically, use this environment variable to disable multi-threading.

EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DIR_SPACE_LIMIT* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the lower limit of the disk space (in gigabytes) of the project directory.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DIR_SPACE_LIM IT 100 means that the lower limit for the disk space of the cell view directory is 100G. This lower limit is checked when launching a simulation run. If the currently available disk space is less than this lower limit, the simulation run will be aborted. If this environment variable is not set, or set to a string which cannot be converted to a number, no disk space checking will take place.

EMY_AETHER_PLOT_DISPLAY_NUM

Value Type int Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the display number to be bound to Xvfb, and is applied to the MDE Platform savePlotSnapShot API.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_PLOT_DISPLAY_NUM 60 means that the plot screenshot will be executed in the virtual window 60.

EMY_AETHER_PLOT_WITH_PARAMETER*

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls whether to print simulation parameters information to logFileIndex.

setenv EMY_AETHER_PLOT_WITH_PARAMETER 0 means that it will not print simulation parameters information to logFileIndex. The default value is 1.

EMY_AETHER_PRINT_SPECIAL_IE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the mixed-signal whether to use a2d/bidir register when exporting netlist.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_PRINT_SPECIAL_IE means that when exporting netlist, the a2d/bidir register will not be extracted.

##### EMY_AETHER_PROBE_FLYLINE_STYLE

Value Type bool Description This environment variable creates ﬂy line cartoon. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_PROBE_FLYLINE_STYLE 1 means that the ﬂy line cartoon will be from the instance terminal or pin of a wider bitwidth net to the net-connected pins or instance terminals of another net.

EMY_AETHER_PURGE_LIB*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to purge the library before importing GDS/OASIS.

EMY_AETHER_PVDB_STOPCELL_LIST Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable controls the ﬁle path for reading ’stop cells’. For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_PVDB_STOPCELL_LIST stopcell.list means that the list of ’stop cells’ will be loaded from the ﬁle speciﬁed as ’stopcell.list’.

EMY_AETHER_REPEAT_COPY_OLD_VERSION

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the Repeat Copy uses an older version.

EMY_AETHER_RESET_COPY_FORM

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable is set to restore the x, y in the delta item and rows, columns in the array item to their default values when the copy command restarts.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_RESET_COPY_FORM means that when the copy command restarts, the x, y in the delta item and the rows, columns in the array item will be restored to their default values.

![image 10940](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10940.png)

![image 10941](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10941.png)

(a) setenv (b) unsetenv

Figure L.10 Reset Copy Form

EMY_AETHER_RIGHT_ZOOM_MINSCOPE Value Type

number

This environment variable sets the length threshold of the right mouse drag. The default value is 27 pixels. The speciﬁed range is [1, 40]. If it is less than the speciﬁed value, it will be considered as the right mouse click. If the environment variable is not set, it will use the default value.

EMY_AETHER_RULER_NO_FILTER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether all rulers are not ﬁltered even if it is small as one point.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_RULER_NO_FILTER means that all rulers are not ﬁltered.

EMY_AETHER_SCHMODIFY_SYMBOL*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether a marker is added to the corresponding instance when the upper-level schematic is opened in edit mode after a modiﬁcation of the lower-level symbol.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_SCHMODIFY_SYMBOL means that after modifying the lower-level symbol, opening the upper-level schematic in edit mode will add markers to the relevant instances.

EMY_AETHER_SCHMODIFY_SYMBOL_RONLY*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the corresponding instance is highlighted when the upper-level schematic is opened (including readonly and edit modes) after a modiﬁcation of the lower-level symbol.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SCHMODIFY_SYMBOL_RONLY means that after modifying the lower-level symbol, opening the upper-level schematic in readonly or edit mode will highlight the relevant instances.

EMY_AETHER_SCH_AUTO_UNIT

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the Auto-Unit function is enabled. When set to 1, it activates the functionality. For descriptions of Auto-Unit function, refer to the SDL Options documentation.

EMY_AETHER_SDL_REUSE_BLOCK_AUTO_ASSIGN_NET

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the behavior of map instances in Reuse Block.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SDL_REUSE_BLOCK_AUTO_ASSIGN_N ET means that if layout instance terminals are not fully matched with schematic instance when mapping, it will automatically assign net of the matched terminals.

EMY_AETHER_SET_WARNING_LABEL_NOT_ATTACH_WIRE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to report the message from error to warning.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SET_WARNING_LABEL_NOT_ATTACH_ WIRE 1 means that can report the message from error to warning.

##### EMY_AETHER_SE_SAME_DESCEND*

This environment variable controls whether to retain the previousely Open In in the Descend Prompt window when descending into instance in the schematic.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SE_SAME_DESCEND means that the previousely Open In in the Descend Prompt window will be retained and not reset by the Open In in the Descend window. This environment also applies to Descend Edit and Descend Read.

EMY_AETHER_SHAPENET_OBTAIN_ENABLE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to enable setting Net Name of Create Path/Bus/Rectangle/Polygon Form by selected objects in current design and Navigator when invokes Create Path/Bus/Rectangle/Polygon Form or selected objects of current design or Navigator change.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SHAPENET_OBTAIN_ENABLE means that Net Name of Create Path Form is ﬁlled by the net of selected shapes when Create Path is invoked.

EMY_AETHER_SKIP_SCH_PARAM_WHEN_GENERATE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the behavior of schematic parameter which is ignored for generation.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_SKIP_SCH_PARAM_WHEN_GENERATE

means that the speciﬁed schematic parameter will be skipped when generate. If you don’t set this environment variable, speciﬁed parameter will use default value.

##### EMY_AETHER_SLEOPEN_DEFAULT_LEL3

##### Description

This environment variable controls the priority of conﬁrming the layout L3 license when opening a layout.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_SLEOPEN_DEFAULT_LEL3 means that the ﬁrst time a layout is opened, the L3 license will be conﬁrmed ﬁrst, and if that fails, then the L2 and the L1 licenses will continue to be conﬁrmed in turn.

EMY_AETHER_SLE_FORM_INITIAL*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the function in Tools -> CDF Editor -> Form Initialization Procedure whether execute in Edit -> Properties action for instances.

EMY_AETHER_SLOT_SKEW_EDGE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether Metal Slot performs slotting on skew edges. If the environment variable is set, slotting will be performed on skew edges; otherwise, slotting will not be performed on skew edges.

![image 10942](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10942.png)

![image 10943](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10943.png)

(a) Don’t Set Environment Variable (b) Set Environment Variable

Figure L.11 Slotting on Skew Edge

##### EMY_AETHER_STARTSDL_UNSAVE_LIBNAME

This environment variable does not save the library name. For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_STARTSDL_UNSAVE_LIBNAME 1 means that when you want to start the SDL function in the schematic, the form will not save the library name of the last SDL.

EMY_AETHER_STRETCH_OLDROUTE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to use the old version of stretching in layout.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_STRETCH_OLDROUTE 1 means that can use the old version of stretching in layout. The old version of the stretch function in the performance will be improved.

EMY_AETHER_SWITCH_LOGVIEWER_THRESHOLD Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable controls the ﬁle size threshold (in MB) for switching between a log ﬁle viewer and the default text editor. Files smaller than or equal to this threshold will be opened with the log ﬁle viewer, while ﬁles larger than this threshold will be opened with the default text editor (e.g., vi).

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_SWITCH_LOGVIEWER_THRESHOLD 4

means that ﬁles larger than 4MB will be opened using the default text editor. A negative threshold value is invalid. If not set or if set to a negative number, the default threshold of 10MB will be used instead.

EMY_AETHER_SYNC_OLD

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the synchronization of the cell whenever the timestamp is diﬀerent.

EMY_AETHER_SYSTEM_LAYER_IMPROVE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to load layers with the same name or number as the system layer.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_SYSTEM_LAYER_IMPROVE 1 means that all layers will be loaded into Aether.

EMY_AETHER_TRACE_CUSTOMOPTIONS_PATH

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to load and save content related to the custom settings form speciﬁc to the ADV trace net within the current startup directory.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_TRACE_CUSTOMOPTIONS_PATH 1 means that the conﬁguration of the custom settings form associated with the ADV trace net is loaded from and saved to the current startup directory, rather than being loaded from and persisted in the library environment where the design ﬁle is opened.

EMY_AETHER_TRACE_NO_CHECK

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to display the warning information while trace net with unchecked schematic. If not set, the warning information is always displayed.

##### EMY_AETHER_UPDATESEL_NOT_FILTER*

This environment variable sets the checked in and not locked button on the SOS update selection form to enabled.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_UPDATESEL_NOT_FILTER means that when ﬁrst time start update selection form, it will display the status as checked in and not locked ﬁles.

EMY_AETHER_USED_VERILOG2K_PARSER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to parser the ".v" ﬁle by Verilog-2001 or systemVerilog standard.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_USED_VERILOG2K_PARSER means that use the Verilog-2001 standard to parser the ".v" ﬁle. If you don’t set this environment variable, it will use systemVerilog standard to parser.

EMY_AETHER_VER_UPDATE_CLEARDIR*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to clean up the removed cellview directory, when user update the version managed data.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_VER_UPDATE_CLEARDIR means that version update action will help user to clean up the removed cellview’s directory. If not set, unmanaged ﬁles in cellview directory, will not be removed, during an update.

EMY_AETHER_VERILOG_NO_PARAMETER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable determines whether to retrieve parameters from the Verilog ﬁle.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_VERILOG_NO_PARAMETER means that the parameters will not be retrieved from the Verilog ﬁle.

EMY_AETHER_VERLOG_IN

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls menu commands for importing netlist. Setting this environment variable DM -> Import -> Netlist will start the Import Verilog command, and vice versa for the Import Netlist command.

EMY_AETHER_VERSION_DIFF_LOCATIONS

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to compare the connection relationship and geometry properties of ojbects such as Port/Instance/Net/ Net Property/Cell/Cell Property/Note when comparing circuit diagrams.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_VERSION_DIFF_LOCATIONS means that when comparing circuit diagrams of diﬀerent versions through diﬀ function, the connection relationship of Port/Instance/Net/Net Property/Cell/Cell Property/Note and the geometry properties of Port/Instance/ Net Property can be compared.

EMY_AETHER_VER_BITPIN_TOL

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to check the pin which exists in symbol.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_VER_BITPIN_TOL means that it will not check the pin which exists in symbol. If you don’t set this environment variable, it will check the pin which exists in symbol.

##### EMY_AETHER_VER_DELETE_DEF

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable sets the default option of SOS delete form to Workarea.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_VER_DELETE_DEF means that when ﬁrst time start version delete form, delete option will be from Workarea, not from Project.

EMY_AETHER_WIRENET_OBTAIN_DISABLE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to disable setting Net Name of Create Wire/Wire Bus Form by selected objects in current design and Navigator when invokes Create Wire/Wire Bus Form or selected objects of current design or Navigator change.

For example:

setenv EMY_AETHER_WIRENET_OBTAIN_DISABLE menas that Net Name of Create Wire Form is always empty when Create Wire is invoked.

EMY_AETHER_WIRESTUBS_OFFSET*

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls the oﬀset of labels created by the Wire Stubs And Names and it can take any integer value from -8 to 32.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_WIRESTUBS_OFFSET 10 means that the oﬀset of labels created by the Wire Stubs And Names is 10.

EMY_AETHER_XRCORNER_NOTALIGN_ARRAY*

Value Type bool

##### Description

This environment variable controls whether, when selecting in X Panel -> X R Corner and clicking Apply or OK, the left or right side of the guideline utilized routing and placement within the Panel’s R-corner area aligns with the corresponding contour of the Pixel Array.

For example: setenv EMY_AETHER_XRCORNER_NOTALIGN_ARRAY means

that the guideline is derived from the contours of the pixel array and blockages being merged, with concave points removed, resulting in a ﬁnal contour used as the reference for routing and placement operations. If it is not set, additional alignment of the left and right sides to the pixel array’s contour must be performed after merging and removing concave points. As shown in the following ﬁgure:

![image 10944](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10944.png)

![image 10945](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10945.png)

(a) Set Environment Variable (b) Don’t Set Environment Variable

Figure L.12 X R Corner

EMY_AETHER_ZTERM_MAXNUMBLOCK_BY10K

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls the maximum number of text blocks (by 10K) a ZTerm tab can show.

setenv EMY_AETHER_ZTERM_MAXNUMBLOCK_BY10K 10

means that the ZTerm tab can show up to 100000 blocks of text. If this environment variable is not set, set to a non-integer value or an integer value less than 1, the maximum number of text blocks will be 10000 (i.e., 10K). If this environment variable is set to a value larger than 130, the maximum number of text blocks will be 1300000. A text block in a ZTerm tab is normally equivalent to a line which ends with a carriage return.

EMY_ANNOTATE_IN_NEW_WIN*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to annotate voltage or current when descending into the new window in MDEL2.

For example:

setenv EMY_ANNOTATE_IN_NEW_WIN means that the annotations will appear in the new window. If this environment variable is not set, the annotations will not appear in the new window.

EMY_ARGUS_INITCOLOR_AFTERCLEAR*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the next highlight color starts from the initial color after each clear highlight.

For example: setenv EMY_ARGUS_INITCOLOR_AFTERCLEAR 1 means that using the initial color after highlighting is cleared.

EMY_CREATEPIN_IGNORE_SAMEPIN

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the creation behavior of Edit -> Advanced -> Create Pin By Instance.

setenv EMY_CREATEPIN_IGNORE_SAMEPIN means that if there is any pin ﬁgures present, for the net of the instance term, no pin ﬁgure will be created. Conversely, only one pin ﬁgure will be created.

EMY_EXPORT_GDS_USE_DEFAULT_VALUE

Value Type bool Description

This variable controls whether to set default value of Export GDS after restarting the Aether .

EMY_EXPORT_GDS_USE_OLD_VERSION*

Value Type bool Description

This variable controls which version of stream out execution are called when using Export GDS

EMY_IMPORT_GDS_USE_DEFAULT_VALUE

Value Type bool Description

This variable controls whether to set default value of Import GDS after restarting the Aether .

EMY_IMPORT_GDS_USE_OLD_VERSION*

Value Type bool Description

This variable controls which version of stream in execution are called when using Import GDS

##### EMY_ONLY_SUPPORT_INTANDSTRING_TYPE*

This environment variable controls whether supper master only supports int and string parameter.

For example: setenv EMY_ONLY_SUPPORT_INTANDSTRING_TYPE 1 means that it will only support int and string parameter.

##### EMY_SUPPORT_PORTING_DATA

Value Type bool Description This environment variable supports data migration. For example: setenv EMY_SUPPORT_PORTING_DATA 1 means that Check And Save appends some information to support data migration.

##### EXPORT_NETLIST_FROM_FILES

Value Type bool Description This environment variable controls whether to export netlist from ﬁles. For example:

setenv EXPORT_NETLIST_FROM_FILES 1 means that load form.rc and aether.rc when exporting netlist by using command line. If you don’t set this environment variable, it will not load ﬁles.

EXPORT_PINORDER_BY_ASCII

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the ASCII pin output order when CDF term order and pin order are not speciﬁed during netlist generation.

For example:

setenv EXPORT_PINORDER_BY_ASCII means that the pins are output in ASCII order. If you don’t set this environment variable, the pins are output in the order of input, output, and inputOutput.

##### EXPORT_PIN_UNIQ

Value Type bool Description

For outputting netlist, this environment variable controls whether duplicate pins are removed.

For example:

setenv EXPORT_PIN_UNIQ means that it will remove duplicate pins. If you don’t set this environment variable, duplicate pins will not be removed.

GU_DIRECT_DRAW_RUB_CART

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the drawing method of mouse marker and highlights.

For example: setenv GU_DIRECT_DRAW_RUB_CART means that the mouse

marker and highlights are drawed directly to the view, which can reduce mouse delay. If it is not set, draw the mouse marker and highlights to a pixmap ﬁrst, then draw the pixmap to the view.

IGNORED_LIBS_FOR_MC* Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable controls whether ﬁlter the speciﬁed libraries for Specify Instances Of Monte Carlo(Unspeciﬁed)(Simulation -> Run Monte Carlo) operation. If multiple libraries need to be ﬁltered, the library names must be separated by spaces. If this environment variable is not set, Aether will ﬁlter the libraries “analog analogLib basic sheet” .

##### IGNORE_CHANGE_CELLNAME

This environment variable controls whether to add __pcell suﬃx for switch device when exporting Verilog.

For example:

setenv IGNORE_CHANGE_CELLNAME means that the cell name of switch device will be ignored suﬃx. If you don’t set this environment variable, the cell name will be added __pcell suﬃx.

IGNORE_FLEX_RC_FILE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether $HOME/.ﬂexlmrc is backed up or deleted at startup.

For example: setenv IGNORE_FLEX_RC_FILE means that the $HOME/.ﬂexlmrc ﬁle will be deleted at startup.

MDE_DUMP_ZTERM_CONTENT_ON_JOB_DISTRIBUTOR

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to dump sleGuiZterm.txt. Setting it to any string will turn on this functionality.

For example:

setenv MDE_DUMP_ZTERM_CONTENT_ON_JOB_DISTRIBUTO R means that sleGuiZterm.txt will be dumped. If you don’t set this environment variable, sleGuiZterm.txt will be not dumped.

MDE_MISMATCH_CALC_INRUNNING*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to calculate mismatch contribution when a simulation run is running in MDEL2. Setting it to any string will turn on this functionality.

For example:

setenv MDE_MISMATCH_CALC_INRUNNING means that the mismatch contribution is calculated in when a simulation run is running. If you don’t set this environment variable, the mismatch contribution is calculated after simulation ﬁnishes.

MDE_PARAM_COPY_HIER* Value Type

string

##### Description

For MDEL2 -> Setup -> Parameters -> Copy From Cellview, this environment variable controls whether to show a conﬁrmation message box which asks whether to copy parameters from the corresponding design’s top cell view only or to copy recursively from the whole design hierarchy.

For example:

setenv MDE_PARAM_COPY_HIER yes means that the conﬁrmation dialog will not be popped up and only the parameters from the top cell view will be copied. setenv MDE_PARAM_COPY_HIER no or sets any string other than yes or no means that the conﬁrmation dialog will not be popped up and all parameters from the whole design hierarchy will be copied. If you don’t set this environment, the conﬁrmation dialog will be popped up.

MDE_PLAT_NUM_SIMS_UPPER_LIMIT* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes the upper limit of the simulation points for a simulation run. When a simulation run starts, the run is checked against this limit. If the number of simulation points is larger than this upper limit, a conﬁrmation dialog will be popped up asking whether to continue.

For example:

setenv MDE_PLAT_NUM_SIMS_UPPER_LIMIT 200 means that it sets the limit to 200. If this environment variable is not set or set to a value that cannot be converted to an integer, the default value 1000 takes eﬀect.

NOISE_SUMMARY_DISPLAY* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the minimum number of displayed rows for each noise summary table when there are multiple noise summary tables on the Simulation Results.

For example: setenv NOISE_SUMMARY_DISPLAY 6 means that each table displays at least 6 rows of data on the Simulation Results.

NONDEFAULTRULES Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable controls path segment in routes with nondefault width. If a path segment in the route has a width that is not the default value, the non-default rule will be dumped.

NOT_OPEN_NAV_WHILE_ONLY_1_SE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the state of Navigator when opening schematic. When this environment variable is set, Navigator will not open when the main window opens schematic for the ﬁrst time.

NOT_PROPAGATE_WREAL_NET Value Type

string

##### Description

This environment variable speciﬁes wreal parameters which will be not output when exporting Verilog.

For example:

setenv NOT_PROPAGATE_WREAL_NET “VSS:VDD” means that the wreal parameter VSS and VDD will be not output when exporting Verilog. If you don’t set this environment variable, wreal parameters will be output.

##### PANDA_ADVFLYLINE_MAX_BRANCH_NUM

##### Value Type

number

##### Description

This variable sets the maximum branch number of one ﬂy line when displaying ﬂy line.

PANDA_DISABLE_ABUT*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable disables the execution of Abut or Unabut operation after editing actions.

For example:

setenv PANDA_DISABLE_ABUT means that abut or unabut would not be execute, even if the option Options -> Abut Options -> Abut Engine has been checked.

PANDA_DISABLE_PACK_RC

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable enables minimum-area layout generation through the Generate All From Schematic command.

For example:

setenv PANDA_DISABLE_PACK_RC means that will not layout for the minimum area. If you don’t set this environment variable, it will layout for the minimum area, and the position of the devices may change.

![image 10946](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10946.png)

![image 10947](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10947.png)

(a) Disable minimum area (b) Enable minimum area

Figure L.13 Generate minimum area

PANDA_FOLLOW_MASK_CUTS

Value Type bool Description

Conﬁgure More Options For Via for Create-> Wire, this environment variable controls the direction of cut layer according to the Layer Number.

∗ Lower : The direction of generated cut layer follows the metal layer with small Layer Number.

∗ Higher : The direction of generated cut layer follows the metal layer with large Layer Number.

![image 10948](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10948.png)

Figure L.14 The direction of cut layer

PANDA_LOG_CONSOLE_LEVEL Value Type

number

##### Description

This variable controls how messages are output. Messages are divided by diﬀerent level: 0:trace, 1:debug, 2:info, 3:warning, 4:error 5:fatal.

PANDA_LOG_FILE_LEVEL Value Type

number

##### Description

This variable controls how messages are output. Messages are divided by diﬀerent level: 0:trace, 1:debug, 2:info, 3:warning, 4:error 5:fatal.

PANDA_LOG_TAG Value Type

string

##### Description

This variable setting is equivalent to the PANDA_TRACE_INFO variable. For detailed information, refer to the PANDA_TRACE_INFO variable.

PANDA_MAX_SIZE_CUTS

Value Type bool Description

For Create -> Via operation Auto mode, under the same condition as the equivalent, it will take the cut class which will create the largest cut layer area. If the environment variable is not set or the value is not 0, it will take eﬀect.

![image 10949](Aether_Manual_crop_images/imageFile10949.png)

Figure L.15 Cut layer area

##### PANDA_SUPPORT_TK

Value Type bool Description Control whether TCL can call TK to create a graphical user interface. For example: setenv PANDA_SUPPORT_TK means that TCL can call TK. If you don’t set this environment variable, TCL can not call TK.

PANDA_TRACE_INFO Value Type

string

##### Description

This variable is a very special variable. It could be one value or combination of values. Now Aether has released the following values:

∗ TRACE_PRINT_PAINT_TIME : If this value is set, the time statistics of display, for example, after activated Zoom In, Zoom Out, Fit and so on, the statistics will printed.

∗ TRACE_HUNTER_SHOW : If this value is set, Aether will show

Hunter in Design Manager -> Tools. ∗ TRACE_DRAW_FIN : If this value is set, the Fin will be drawn. ∗ TRACE_ADE_ONLY_SP_FILE : If this value is set, Aether will only generate the netlist and sp ﬁle and do not call the simulator.

∗ TRACE_SLE_ADE : If this value is set, Aether will generate the corresponding annotation ﬁle named sleGuiAnnotateEval.txt based on simulation.

For example:

setenv PANDA_TRACE_INFO TRACE_PRINT_PAINT_TIME| TRACE_DRAW_FIN means that Aether will print the time statistics and draw the ﬁn.

||Note: This variable only works when the environment variable PANDA_LOG_CONSOLE_LEVEL is set.|
|---|
|
|---|


##### SLE_ENABLE_SYMBOL_MARKER* Value Type

bool Description

This environment variable controls whether markers can be created in symbol and whether the Find Marker and Delete All Marker can be used.

For example:

setenv SLE_ENABLE_SYMBOL_MARKER 1 means that markers can be created in symbol and the Find Marker and Delete All Marker can be used. If user does not set this environment variable, markers can not be created in symbol and the Find Marker and Delete All Marker can not be used.

SLE_FIND_OBJ_COLOR Value Type

number

Description Specify the layer number. For example: setenv SLE_FIND_OBJ_COLOR 5 means that 5 is for found objects layer number.

SLE_MDE_AHDLLIBDIR

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether -ahdllibdir of Simulation Option is to be dumped into the netlist ﬁles during a simulation run. Setting it to any string will turn oﬀ the dumping functionality.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_AHDLLIBDIR means that it stops the -ahdllibdir from being dumped into the netlist ﬁles. If this environment variable is not set, the -ahdllibdir will be dumped into the netlist ﬁle.

SLE_MDE_ALPSCD_TERMINAL* Value Type

string

This environment variable speciﬁes the terminal through which Circuit Diagnoser is launched.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_ALPSCD_TERMINAL ’gnome-terminal -t “Circuit Diagnoser” –wait – bash -c “%s” ’ means that the Circuit Diagnoser will use gnome-terminal. If this environment variable is not set or set to an empty string, the default terminal is xterm.

SLE_MDE_EXPORT_EXPRLIST*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to export exprlist.csv ﬁle to the current working directory when a simulation run is launched. Setting it to any string will turn on the exporting functionality.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_EXPORT_EXPRLIST means that it turns on exporting. If you don’t set this environment variable, the exprlist.csv ﬁle will not be exported.

SLE_MDE_HIGH_PERFORMANCE_MODE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to display Simulation Performance Mode in High Performance. Setting it to any string turns on this functionality.

For example: setenv SLE_MDE_HIGH_PERFORMANCE_MODE means that it turns on this functionality. If this environment variable is not set, Simulation Performance Mode will not be displayed.

SLE_MDE_NOT_CHECK_PROBE_INSTANCE*

Value Type bool

This environment variable controls whether to check Probe Instance in STB analysis. Setting it to any string disables the checking.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_NOT_CHECK_PROBE_INSTANCE means that it disables the checking. If this environment variable is not set, Probe Instance will be checked.

SLE_MDE_NO_MMSIM*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to output lib.cfg, lib.map and ﬁleInputs.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_NO_MMSIM means that lib.cfg, lib.map and ﬁleInputs are not output. If you don’t set this environment variable, lib.cfg, lib.map and ﬁleInputs are output.

SLE_MDE_SAVE_RESULT_NO_SCIENTIFIC

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to transform the result values to into scientiﬁc notation when saving them to a ﬁle. Setting it to any string disables the transformation.

For example:

setenv SLE_MDE_SAVE_RESULT_NO_SCIENTIFIC means that it disables the transformation. If this environment variable is not set, transformation will be done.

SLE_NETLIST_INSTANCE_DELIMITER

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the bus delimiter takes eﬀect on the instance name when exporting netlist.

setenv SLE_NETLIST_INSTANCE_DELIMITER means that the bus delimiter will not take eﬀect on instance name.

SLE_NETLIST_NIL_TO_ZERO

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether the parameter is 0 or nil when exporting netlist.

For example: setenv SLE_NETLIST_NIL_TO_ZERO means that when exporting the netlist, if the parameter value in SUBCKT row is empty, output 0.

SLE_OPT_DIMMING_SHARE

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable shares the display options. If it set, diﬀerent libraries will share display options.

For example: setenv SLE_OPT_DIMMING_SHARE means that diﬀerent libraries can share one set of display options.

SLE_SDL_PRBOUNDARY_SNAP_TO_MINORSPACE*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to snap to the minor space for PRBoundary generated from the schematic.

For example: setenv SLE_SDL_PRBOUNDARY_SNAP_TO_MINORSPACE 1 , means that PRBoundary generated from schematic will snap to minor space.

SLE_VERILOG_NOT_PRINT_PIN*

Value Type bool

##### Description

This environment variable controls whether print pin name when exporting Verilog.

For example:

setenv SLE_VERILOG_NOT_PRINT_PIN means that the pin name will be not printed when exporting Verilog. If you don’t set this environment variable, pin name will be printed.

SLE_VERILOG_SHORT

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to short when exporting Verilog.

For example:

setenv SLE_VERILOG_SHORT means that the Short feature will be enabled, when exporting Verilog. If you don’t set this environment variable, short will be disabled.

SUPER_PAINT_DILUTE_RATE* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets dilute rate when Options -> Settings -> Editor -> Shadow Surrounding Objects In Edit In Place Command is checked. The speciﬁed range is [0,100]. When 0 is speciﬁed, it is displayed normally. When 100 is speciﬁed, it is not displayed. As the value increases, the display gets darker.

SUPER_PAINT_EIP_FILTER_RATIO* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ratio of ﬁlter size for EIP in MT mode (opened by layout with MT).

setenv SUPER_PAINT_EIP_FILTER_RATIO 5 means that the ﬁlter size for EIP is magniﬁed 5 times, so any more shapes in EIP smaller than this ﬁlter size will not be displayed.

SUPER_PAINT_FILTER_LEVEL_0* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ﬁlter size in millimeter which is number and greater than zero for displaying. The ﬁlter size is the minimum size which object could be displayed. It works when Options -> Settings -> Filter Level = 0.

∗ > 0: The layout will be displayed according to the speciﬁed value. ∗ 0: The layout will be displayed in full mode.

SUPER_PAINT_FILTER_RATIO* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ratio of ﬁlter size in MT mode (opened by layout with MT).

For example:

setenv SUPER_PAINT_FILTER_RATIO 10 means that the ﬁlter size is magniﬁed 10 times, so any more shapes smaller than this ﬁlter size will not be displayed.

SUPER_PAINT_FUZZY_RATIO* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ratio of instance fuzzy size. The value is a percentage and the speciﬁed range is [0,100].

For example:

setenv SUPER_PAINT_FUZZY_RATIO 0 means that it will display details in instances. setenv SUPER_PAINT_FUZZY_RATIO 50 means that it will set the instance fuzzy size to 50 percent. When width or height

of an instance is smaller than this fuzzy size, it will only display the box of this instance.

SUPER_PAINT_LAYER_PRIORITY* Value Type

string

Description This environment variable sets the display priority of layers. For example:

setenv SUPER_PAINT_LAYER_PRIORITY “M2:drawing M1:drawing” means that M2 is displayed preferentially than M1, and they are both displayed on the top of other layers.

SUPER_PAINT_MT*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls the multi-threading display. If it is not set, the multi-threading display turns oﬀ.

∗ 1: Turn on the multi-threading display. ∗ 0: Turn oﬀ the multi-threading display.

SUPER_PAINT_MT_NUM* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the thread number which is a positive integer when SUPER_PAINT_MT is set. If SUPER_PAINT_MT is not set, it does not work.

SUPER_PAINT_REALTIME*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls real-time display. Especially, the speciﬁed data amount can be displayed immediately after drawing on the design area. If it is not set, the real-time display turns oﬀ.

∗ 1: Turn on the real-time display. ∗ 0: Turn oﬀ the real-time display.

SUPER_PAINT_REALTIME_LIMIT* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the minimum amount of data for realtime display. This amount of data represents the sum of the types of graphics(instances, shapes, and so on) and the number of layers. The default value is 100.

SUPER_PAINT_REALTIME_STEP* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the refresh rate that how much data (the sum of the types of graphics(instances, shapes and so on) and the number of layers) will be displayed once after drawing. The default value is 20.

SUPER_PAINT_REUSE_FITMAP*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether to reuse the pixmap of ﬁt or not.

For example: setenv SUPER_PAINT_REUSE_FITMAP 1 means that the pixmap of ﬁt is saved and will be reused next time to speed up ﬁt.

SUPER_PAINT_TEXT_FILTER* Value Type

number

##### Description

This environment variable sets the ﬁlter size of the text. The unit is millimeters and the default value is 1.2 millimeters. Nothing will be displayed when the text is less than the speciﬁed value.

SUPER_PAINT_TRACE_NET_NO_FILTER*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether trace net highlights are not ﬁltered even if it is small as one point.

For example: setenv SUPER_PAINT_TRACE_NET_NO_FILTER 1 means that all trace net highlights are not ﬁltered.

SYNC_DESIGN_THREAD_JUDGE

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls the number of the judgment threads when the editable or read-only mode is triggered.

For example:

setenv SYNC_DES IGN_THREAD_JUDGE 4 means that four judgment threads will be created to handle the transition when the design is made editable or read-only.

SYNC_DESIGN_THREAD_MONITOR

Value Type int Description

This environment variable controls the number of background monitor threads that are started when switching a design to editable or read-only mode.

For example: setenv SYNC_DESIGN_THREAD_MONITOR 4 means that four monitor threads will be started in the background.

||Note: When SYNC_DESIGN_THREAD_MONITOR is set, the SYNC_DESIGN_THREAD_JUDGE environment is ignored.|

VERILOG_MODULE_NOT_RENAME*

Value Type bool Description

This environment variable controls whether print cell name when exporting Verilog.

For example:

setenv VERILOG_MODULE_NOT_RENAME means that when exporting the Verilog, the module does not need to be renamed for the same cell in diﬀerent libraries.
